title: This Totally Free App Can Free Up Space on Your Mac

claims.claim: Purge, Mac kullanıcılarının sabit disklerinde yer kaplayan dosyaları görmesini ve temizlemesini sağlayan tamamen ücretsiz ve açık kaynaklı bir uygulamadır.

evidence.quote: This totally free, open source app gives you a quick breakdown of what's taking up space on your hard drive and offers a few specific ways to free it up.

claims.claim: Purge uygulaması reklamlara veya eklenti satışlarına yer vermemektedir.

evidence.quote: There are no ads or upsells.
Even better: There are no ads or upsells.

claims.claim: Purge, macOS 27 sürümündeki Apple Intelligence çevrim dışı modellerini silebilir.

evidence.quote: Purge can even delete Apple Intelligence's offline models from macOS 27
Purge can even delete Apple Intelligence's offline models from macOS 27, which could free up over 10 GB.

claims.claim: Apple Intelligence modellerinin silinmesi 10 GB'tan fazla alan açabilir.

evidence.quote: Purge can even delete Apple Intelligence's offline models from macOS 27, which could free up over 10 GB.

claims.claim: Purge, dosyaları doğrudan silmek yerine Çöp Kutusu'na gönderir.

evidence.quote: Finally, Purge sends files to the Trash instead of deleting them outright, so you can always recover them if something breaks.

claims.claim: Purge uygulaması, halihazırda silinmiş olan uygulamaların geride bıraktığı verileri de temizleyebilir.

evidence.quote: Speaking of that, there's also a tool that shows leftover data from applications you've already deleted.

Speaking of that, there's also a tool that shows leftover data from applications you've already deleted. In my case, it was several gigabytes, all basically wasted. I highly recommend checking this section and deleting anything large that you're confident you won't use again.

claims.claim: Apple, macOS 27 sürümünde Apple Intelligence özelliklerinin tamamen devre dışı bırakılmasına olanak tanıyan bir seçenek sunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: Apple removed the toggle in macOS 27 that lets you disable them altogether.
